definitions.explanation: A two-piece swimsuit consisting of a top and bottom. Loanword from English, used the same way as in English. Considered a more revealing style of {水着|みずぎ}.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいビキニを{買|か}った。
{白|しろ}いビキニを{着|き}て{海|うみ}で{泳|およ}いだ。
examples.english: I wore a white bikini and swam in the sea.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みに{合|あ}わせて、おしゃれなビキニを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a stylish bikini for summer vacation.

notes:
Loanword from English "bikini." Refers to the two-piece swimsuit style; can be replaced by the longer ビキニタイプの{水着|みずぎ} when contrast with one-piece styles is needed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビキニを{着|き}る: to wear a bikini
- ビキニ{姿|すがた}: bikini-clad figure
- ハイウエストビキニ: high-waisted bikini
- ビキニトップ / ビキニボトム: bikini top / bottom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水着|みずぎ}: swimsuit — general term; includes bikinis, one-pieces, and trunks
- ワンピース{水着|みずぎ}: one-piece swimsuit — explicit contrast term
- タンキニ: tankini — bikini bottom with a longer tank-style top
